history.reference_raw: A/74/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, para. 311 management
history.administration_response: The Administration has mechanisms in place already and it requests the closure of this recommendation. To provide the legislative bodies with sufficient information on human resources planning, reports of the Secretary- General clearly link human resources needs with expected accomplishments and outputs. Missions are requested to adopt a forward- looking approach that focuses on concrete staffing strategies for realizing a number of accomplishments by delivering related key outputs.
history.board_assessment: The Administration provided annex IV to the performance and budget preparation guide. The Board intends to review whether missions and service centre have implemented the provisions of annex IV. This recommendation remains under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: In paragraph 311 of its report, the Board recommended that the Administration base its post requirements on a baseline assessment of functions performed and enhance the documentation of approved posts.
history.reference_raw: Recommendations contained in the report of the Board of Auditors for the 12 -month period ended 30 Jun e 2019 ( A/74/5 (Vol. II)
history.entities_raw: Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance
history.sg_progress: The Administration would like to clarify that the assessment of the overall level of staff is factored into the planning and human resources requirements for all budget proposals on an ongoing basis, bearing in mind, in particular, a mission’s mandate and concept of operations, as part of the due diligence process during the preparation of the budget report of the Secretary-General. Before proposals for additional posts are made, missions seek to accommodate, whenever possible, the functions envisaged for the posts from within their authorized capacity through the redeployment, reassignment, reclassification or conversion of posts. In the budget reports, information is provided to give an insight into the challenges and context of the missions and an understanding of the main elements leading to the staffing requirements, as part of the planning assumptions and mission support initiatives, as well as the various components under the results-based budgeting frameworks. The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.

history.recommendation_text: 19. The Board recommends that the Administration base its post requirements on a baseline assessment of functions performed and enhance the documentation of approved posts. Supply chain management
history.reference_raw: A/74/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the period ended; para. 311
history.administration_response: The Administration stated that missions, in their budget submissions, had provided a summary of long-term vacant posts to demonstrate compliance, namely, that the long- vacant posts had been reviewed and considered for retention, abolishment or other post action. The supplementary information submitted identified the action taken. If posts were to be retained, then information should be provided on the status of recruitment at the time of budget preparation, as well as clear justification of the need for retention. That information was updated several times during the budget proposal process.
history.board_assessment: The Board considers this recommendation as implemented.
